reason: Both are building-products manufacturers selling through distributors to contractors. Owens Corning makes roofing, insulation and doors, plus glass-fiber nonwovens. CSW makes HVAC/R accessories, plumbing products, architectural building components and firestopping, plus industrial lubricants. The product lines do not overlap directly (no shingles or insulation at CSW). The customer overlap is only partial (contractors and distributors, but CSW's contractors are HVAC, plumbing and electrical trades). It is adjacent, not a direct competitor.
